title: BootNotificationResponse
description: Server response to a BootNotificationRequest, indicating acceptance, rejection, or pending status along with operational parameters.

status.description: Result of the boot notification registration.

serverTime.description: Server UTC timestamp for station clock synchronization.

heartbeatIntervalSec.description: Interval in seconds at which the station must send heartbeats.

retryInterval.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Required when status is Rejected or Pending.

errorCode.description: OSPP error code explaining the rejection. Required when status is Rejected.

errorText.description: Machine-readable error name in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Required when status is Rejected.

configuration.description: Optional key-value configuration pairs pushed to the station.

sessionKey.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte HMAC session key. REQUIRED on every Accepted response, unconditionally. It was previously conditional on MessageSigningMode -- which is station configuration, not a field of this message, so the condition was not expressible in JSON Schema and would have stayed prose forever. Under MessageSigningMode None the key is simply unused; issuing one costs 44 bytes and makes the requirement machine-checkable. A station that receives Accepted WITHOUT it MUST treat the response as malformed (Core profile -- BootNotification section 5.3).

supportedVersions.description: Protocol versions supported by server. Required when Rejected with 1007 PROTOCOL_VERSION_MISMATCH.

details.description: Diagnostic detail for the accompanying errorCode. REQUIRED on a Pending response carrying 3018 TOPOLOGY_MISMATCH, where it MUST name what the server expected and what arrived; absent otherwise. A station held out of service for a reason nobody can see is a station nobody can repair, which is why this is required rather than recommended. Closed, like every other object in this schema set: a future error code that needs its own detail adds its member here, and the protocol is unreleased, so that costs a schema edit and nothing else.

expected.description: The topology recorded for this station at provisioning, in the same shape as the request's bays[].

declared.description: The topology this BootNotification declared, echoed back so an operator can compare the two without correlating two messages.
